headline: Colombia Promigas Transport Volume Rises 25% to Drive Higher Revenue
summary: Colombian energy infrastructure firm Promigas reported a 25% increase in natural gas transport volume, driving year-to-date revenues to 5.47 trillion pesos and quarterly EBITDA to 1.81 trillion pesos.
why: Promigas controls major natural gas transmission pipeline networks across Colombia and Peru. Transport performance serves as a key indicator of industrial energy demand.

impacts.name: Promigas SA
impacts.why: Higher natural gas transport volumes expanded operational revenues and core EBITDA performance.
